Go To Animation - 2D Cartoon Animation Studio (gotoanimation / goto animation)

Go To Animation (gotoanimation, go to animation) provides a complete cartoon creation suite directly in your browser. Rig 2D characters, create village and modern animation scenes, manage audio tracks, and export cartoons in full HD.

Top Features of Go To Animation (gotoanimation):

  • Interactive 2D Character Studio & Rigging (Easy Mode & Advanced Mode)
  • Multi-track Timeline with Scene Canvas Viewport (16:9 HD)
  • Motion path animations, speed control, flips, and character moods
  • Offline-first PWA support with instant cloud auto-save
